operations.name: appManagement.get
operations.summary: Fetch one managed app: catalog detail plus management, source and last sync.
operations.notes: Nothing is unwrapped: the body is returned exactly as sent. The body is the catalog detail (`app`, `actions`, `health`, `sourceRef`, `version`, `digest`, `versionCount`, `overlay`, `effective`, `owner`) plus `auths`, `management`, `source` and `lastSync`. Open unions: `ManagementClass`, `UnavailableReason`; closed: `SyncOutcome`. Codes: `400 invalid_path` (malformed id), `404 unknown_app` (also when the caller cannot see the app), a global app is `200` with `management.class: "global"`; any app the caller does not manage (including visible-but-unmanaged) is `404 unknown_app`.

operations.name: appManagement.preview
operations.summary: Preview a source for a target without registering anything.

params.name: source
params.$comment: A canonical remote ref string, or `{folder:{grant,path}}` (a path inside a granted server folder).

params.name: target
params.$comment: `account`, `tenant` or `personal`.

operations.notes: Nothing is unwrapped: the body is returned exactly as sent. Answers `{kind:'app', sourceRef, app}` or `{kind:'pack', sourceRef, pack, entries}`; `entries[].alreadyRegistered` covers only apps the caller manages. The body is built from `source` and `target` only. Codes: `400 invalid_body`, `400 invalid_target`, `400 invalid_source`, `403 forbidden`, `403 local_import_forbidden`, `424 fetch_failed`, `424 source_requires_grant`, `429 source_rate_limited`, `424 source_timeout`, `424 source_too_large`.

operations.name: appManagement.register
operations.summary: Register an app or pack from a source into a target.

params.name: target
params.$comment: `account`, `tenant` or `personal`.

params.name: source
params.$comment: A canonical remote ref string, or `{folder:{grant,path}}` (a path inside a granted server folder).

params.name: paths
params.$comment: Pack sources only; sent only when given.

operations.notes: Nothing is unwrapped: the body is returned exactly as sent. The legacy import shapes (app: 201 or 200; pack: 201, 207 or 200) plus `target`. Codes: `400 invalid_body`, `400 invalid_target`, `400 invalid_source`, `403 forbidden`, `403 user_import_disabled`, `403 local_import_forbidden`, `409 id_taken`, `424 fetch_failed`, `424 source_requires_grant`, `429 source_rate_limited`, `424 source_timeout`, `424 source_too_large`.

operations.name: appManagement.updateSource
operations.summary: Validate a candidate source and, if it loads, make it the app's active source.

params.name: source
params.$comment: A canonical remote ref string, or `{folder:{grant,path}}` (a path inside a granted server folder).

params.name: expectedRevision
params.$comment: The `source.revision` read from the row or detail; `0` when no source is committed.

operations.notes: Nothing is unwrapped: the body is returned exactly as sent. `SyncResult.outcome` is closed: `registry_updated`, `definition_unchanged` or `failed` (a `failed` outcome is still a 200 with `error:{code,message}`). The active source changes only on `registry_updated` or `definition_unchanged`. Codes: `400 invalid_path` (malformed id), `404 unknown_app` (also when the caller cannot see the app), `403 forbidden` (visible but not managed, or global and the caller is not an operator). `409 artifact_backed`, `409 stale_source` (revision mismatch), `403 local_import_forbidden`, `400 invalid_source`, `400 invalid_body`.

operations.name: appManagement.sync
operations.summary: Re-fetch the app's active source and update the registry.

params.name: expectedRevision
params.$comment: Refuse with `409 stale_source` unless this is the current revision. `0` is sent.

operations.notes: Nothing is unwrapped: the body is returned exactly as sent. `SyncResult.outcome` is closed: `registry_updated`, `definition_unchanged` or `failed` (a `failed` outcome is still a 200 with `error:{code,message}`). The body is `{}`, or `{expectedRevision}` when given. Codes: `400 invalid_path` (malformed id), `404 unknown_app` (also when the caller cannot see the app), `403 forbidden` (visible but not managed, or global and the caller is not an operator). `409 artifact_backed`, `409 no_source`, `409 stale_source` (only when `expectedRevision` was sent), `409 sync_conflict` (lost the locked-write race), `403 local_import_forbidden`.

operations.name: appManagement.remove
operations.summary: Remove an app: all its versions and its source row.
operations.notes: Nothing is unwrapped: the body is returned exactly as sent. No request body. Answers `{removed}`. Codes: `400 invalid_path` (malformed id), `404 unknown_app` (also when the caller cannot see the app), `403 forbidden` (visible but not managed, or global and the caller is not an operator). `409 app_in_use`.

operations.name: dataStores.list

cli.$comment: CLI-only surface. Not API operations — requirements the CLI wrapper must satisfy. See docs/cli.md. `commands` are CLI-only commands (no API operation behind them) that gen-help turns into help entries.

help.notes: --help must resolve with no token set and no server reachable. Unknown or incomplete commands print the relevant help to stderr and exit 1.

globalFlags.name: --version
globalFlags.notes: Shares one handler with `w6w version`: prints the CLI VERSION plus the server’s version and composition from an unauthenticated `GET /version` (no Authorization header, ever; 3 s timeout), versions only and no identity. Never fails: an unreachable server prints `server: unavailable (<reason>)` and the exit code is 0.

exitCodes.0: success, including help and a queued/running workflow
